internal_repo_evidence.finding: WP04 requires precise diagnostics; WP11 conformance and WP12 held-out corpus are open BASE obligations.
WP04 negative corpus and WP12 real-checker-diagnostic corpus are receipt-gated closure needs.
reference checker distinguishes DENY_BAD_SIGNATURE, DENY_INTENT_DRIFT, DENY_SCOPE, etc.; lowered path collapses failures to generic DENY.
WP03 runner preserves failures as stage name, command, returncode and stdout/stderr tails but lacks stable diagnostic occurrence identity.
WP11/WP12 conformance corpus workflow landed during this run; it motivates machine-stable diagnostic labels but does not itself define them.
compiler/runtime fuzz gate uses local failure kind strings and exception reprs, creating a concrete integration surface for structured diagnostic identity.

GCC emits structured diagnostics including SARIF 2.1.0 and supports nested diagnostic structure/output sinks.
